assessments.reasoning: The commit-pinned openldap/openldap LICENSE is the cited repository record. Its title, edition line and copyright identify the Net Boolean Public License, version 1, dated August 22, 1998, and attribute it to Net Boolean Incorporated. The complete 5,471-byte acquisition ends at The End and reports the digest in the claim scope. [Pinned OpenLDAP LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openldap/openldap/37b4b3f6cc4bf34e1d3dec61e69914b9819d8894/LICENSE)

The committed Index decision lists prospective entity c0456a298a594f3387dae352cd1f4cf8, corresponding to the claim subject with its e- prefix, under NBPL-1.0. It records Net Boolean Public License v1, kind license, edition nbpl-1-0-captured-reference, revision sha256:00717cf4f0b5939100740a9f4aea62147aad23486a5989e8c604a85ce64c120b and lifecycle historical. [Committed Index decision](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/software-commons/license-index/acce97c2c5dbbf6228c02f95a5f43b5d20c0801e/docs/decisions/five-project-notices-lifecycle-2026-11-28.md)

challenge.method: Checked the pinned OpenLDAP repository path and the file’s attribution to Net Boolean. Read from the title and date through the closing marker, tested the distinction from the Artistic License and OpenLDAP 1.0 release terms, and compared the acquired digest and all identity fields with the NBPL-1.0 row.
challenge.results: The file identifies Net Boolean Incorporated and version 1 dated August 22, 1998, and contains nine numbered provisions through The End. The file expressly distinguishes its terms from the Artistic License. The Index decision identifies OpenLDAP 1.0 release terms as a separate instrument and assigns historical status to the matched NBPL capture.

limitations: The authority finding rests on Net Boolean’s attribution in the cited OpenLDAP repository copy. Historical status applies to lookup of that copy.
OpenLDAP release applicability, other works, legal equivalence, reuse and installation require separate evidence.
Digest checks used the complete-range acquisition metadata. The four authorized acquisitions provide no separate verification of the policy commit or bundle hash.
reasoning: The repository file supplies the instrument’s title, attribution, version and date. The Index decision supplies the display identity and historical classification for the same edition and digest.
